review_scope: Independent source-backed preparation review after freezing whole-unit expectations; no model responses or inference. Author is concurrently correcting drafts; findings bind only snapshots below.

findings.title: Incomplete dependency compilation
findings.finding: OR j345–347 establish reference roles, not notice/cure procedures. OR90.155/160 methods and clocks, chapter applicability and antiwaiver are not compiled. CA j188 preserves an unspecified holiday exception without the applicable calendar; 1983 notice recipients/content/delivery, 1982 lost property, 1986 care, 1988 sale/proceeds, 1989 other-owner protections, 1991 coordination and substantive1965 conditions are missing or only named.
findings.correction: Compile the necessary sourced rules and their links. Do not turn captured references into accepted procedure. Exact calendar calculation and late-return/cost decisions must not require source reconstruction.

findings.title: Missing connections between otherwise present records
findings.finding: No proposed relationship links facility exclusion or space-only limit to entry grants, yard written terms to yard entry, specified allowable times to repair permission, or notice methods to emergency postnotice. General abuse/harassment constraints have no grant-qualifying connection. CA cost-allocation/no-duplicate/rate records lack links to relevant return/payment conditions; premises waiver is linked to the dwelling waiver as overlapping, but not to ordinary storage-payment condition.
findings.correction: Add independently judged scope, applicability and qualification edges. Explain exact graph interpretation so isolated waivers cannot operate unconditionally and global constraints cannot disappear.

findings.title: Accepted predicates still require rereading source
findings.finding: Both CA cost records propose the identical predicate: claimant is the actor named in this selected subdivision. This retains a deictic reference instead of tenant-versus-other-owner meaning. OR written notice predicate compresses distinct delivery locations into a listed-method phrase; definitions and section pointers alone do not license which method applies to which actor.
findings.correction: Use self-contained predicates with explicit claimant categories and delivery recipients/locations. Runtime fact jobs must operate on accepted meanings, not infer omitted law from source excerpts.

findings.title: Choice alternatives overlap or lose the needed answer
findings.affected: OR j128; CA j127; OR repair_expiration
findings.finding: OR j128 INTERVAL=None and NO_FIXED_INTERVAL describe the same result. CA j127 depositing notice in mail overlaps NOTICE_DISPATCH. Expiration actor menu is built around a person although authorization expires by operation of law; emergency waiver object candidates combine tenant or entry time.
findings.correction: Make answer alternatives distinct and include actorless legal consequence where appropriate; split recipient and temporal object. Do not call a duplicate-option disagreement a semantic error.

findings.title: Branch conditions and dependency licensing are insufficiently bound
findings.affected: OR j306–307; CA j132; relationship jobs generally
findings.finding: OR damages jobs mention weekly/nonweekly conditions in option prose but license only number/unit to weekly_floor/other_floor, not an explicit applicability predicate or floor operator. CA j132 licenses both interval/event mappings independently of the granular timing jobs, creating overlapping authority for the same meaning; no consistency rule states what happens if answers conflict. Most relationship jobs require endpoint actor/action/object/modality only, although the question also asserts conditions, timing or scope.
findings.correction: Store conditional mappings and amount operator explicitly; either use one audited compound judgment or reconcile duplicated authority. Make readiness depend on the precise fields a relationship asserts, including logical conditions, not merely record identity.

findings.title: Generic relation labels leave execution semantics unproven
findings.finding: Labels such as qualifies_authorization_duration, alternative_time_rule and distinct_overlapping_no_cost_rule do not by themselves specify which condition is negated, overridden or inherited. The source-specific question includes more legal meaning than the licensed edge.
findings.correction: Specify and review relation semantics and affected field paths. Demonstrate seven-day exception, specified-time enforcement and simultaneous no-cost return without consumer rereading the source or inventing edge behavior.

findings.title: Questions test authored propositions with uneven alternatives
findings.affected: Field action/object jobs and relationship jobs
findings.finding: Action/object choices usually offer one authored candidate and generic rejection alternatives; many relationship questions package several propositions in a favorable candidate. This can validate a supplied candidate but cannot establish that all missing candidates were discovered. Several choices ask modality for an incomplete selected expression without stating the selected candidate action in state; polarity of obtain-consent versus enter therefore depends on preparer context.
findings.correction: Treat performance as candidate validation, not autonomous decomposition. Include explicit selected action in modality state and reject or repair compound/ambiguous candidates. Preserve the separate whole-unit omission denominator.

findings.title: Actual changed-case consumer behavior has not been demonstrated
findings.finding: Both preparations have an empty changed_case_inputs list and one generic runtime fact-classification template. No execution has occurred; a prose no-source-access promise does not prove that a consumer can issue all concurrent duties, calculate lawful dates/costs, or ask the right unknown-fact questions.
findings.correction: Run varied independently judged cases only after the legal records are complete; record actual input/output and source-access traces. Preserve unknown/disputed facts and account separately for unanswered semantics, incorrect semantics, missing components, missing links and consumer defects.

coverage_status_meaning: represented means an appropriate proposed job/record exists, not that Jev established it or downstream execution passed. partial/missing are material to completeness; no aggregate passing score is assigned.
independent_denominator_addendum: Preparation includes the applicable statutory definition of good faith (ORS90.100(21), honesty in fact), which the frozen OR expectations cited through full90.100 but did not explicitly articulate. This is a source-supported additional component to preserve in the completeness denominator, not a reason to change any expected case outcome. Expectations are unchanged.
